task_title: Route starter + merchant weapons through the equipment system (mainHand/offHand)

plan_review.notes: approved-with-notes; 3 valid concerns addressed: (1) selectFloor1StarterWeapon/applyFloor1LoadoutChoice check equip result.ok and fall back to setActiveWeapon; module-load validation added that every weapon-equipment def references a real WeaponDef and every starter weaponId resolves; (2) STARTER_WEAPON_ID_TO_ITEM_ID exported from equipmentDefs.ts and consumed by floorScenario.ts (single source of truth, duplicate FLOOR_1_STARTER_WEAPON_TO_SHOP_ITEM_ID deleted); (3) equipPurchasedGear loops all equippable slugs so a purchased hand weapon that cannot equip does not stall the charm; auto-swap-starter deferred as intentional UX (weapons ARE equippable per user spec; slot-conflict resolution is a separate follow-up). Rubber duck also flagged a 4th non-blocking suggestion (getShopkeeperPostQuestStock filters starterChoices not selectedWeaponId) but that behavior is pre-existing and unrelated to this feature; tracked as a follow-up.

rounds.notes: High-severity finding: on reused GameWorlds (dev tools/respawn/re-run of loadout modal) the previous run leaves mainHand occupied; equip() fails with occupiedSlot and applyFloor1LoadoutChoice silently discards the failure while combat routes through setActiveWeapon fallback. Fixed in eb7d6ecd: both selectFloor1StarterWeapon and applyFloor1LoadoutChoice now force-unequip mainHand+offHand before force-equipping the starter, and applyFloor1LoadoutChoice checks result.ok with the same setActiveWeapon fallback. Regression test added covering loadout re-run (sword then bow on the same world).

Re-review of eb7d6ecd on top of e073f0c5. No new blocking concerns. Pre-unequip is idempotent (safe on empty slot), 2H shared-instance unequip is handled cleanly by equipmentSystem, applyFloor1LoadoutChoice fallback matches selectFloor1StarterWeapon semantics.
